title: Sunita Devi v. Registrar of Co-operative Societies & Anr.

brief.about: The appellant was removed from membership of the Shakti Nagar Co-operative House Building Society by a resolution dated 11.04.2022, confirmed by the Registrar on 20.06.2022, for alleged default in instalments. She says she paid Rs. 7,80,000 and holds receipts.
brief.last: Arguments of the appellant heard in part. Counsel relied on the bank statement showing withdrawals matching the four disputed receipts. Part-heard.

orders.summary: The appellant was removed from membership of the Shakti Nagar Co-operative House Building Society by a resolution dated 11.04.2022, confirmed by the Registrar on 20.06.2022, for alleged default in instalments. She says she paid Rs. 7,80,000 and holds receipts.
directions: The society shall not allot Flat No. B-204 to any other person till further orders.

orders.summary: Reply of the society is filed. The Registrar adopts it. The society disputes four receipts as forged.
directions: The appellant is directed to produce the originals.

orders.summary: Original receipts are produced and seen. The society is directed to produce its cash book and receipt counterfoils for the period January 2019 to March 2021.
directions: The society is directed to produce its cash book and receipt counterfoils for the period January 2019 to March 2021.

orders.summary: The cash book is produced. The counterfoils for four receipts are stated to be missing. Counsel for the society seeks time to file an affidavit of the treasurer.
directions: Counsel for the society seeks time to file an affidavit of the treasurer.

orders.summary: Affidavit of the treasurer is filed. Parties state that pleadings are complete.
Arguments of the appellant heard in part. Counsel relied on the bank statement showing withdrawals matching the four disputed receipts. Part-heard.
